ato:component:title: Avatar Texture Optimizer
ato:component:desc: Analyses the avatar meshes, rescales UV islands to the requested perceptual quality and repacks them into atlases. Nothing but textures, UVs and meshes is touched.
ato:generateAtlas:tip: When disabled the tool only rescales whole textures and optimises import settings. UV islands are not cropped or repacked.
ato:qualityTier:tip: Target quality tier. Lossless copies textures untouched; Custom keeps your own values.
ato:progress:title: Avatar Texture Optimizer

ato:error:multipleComponents:description: An avatar may contain only one Avatar Texture Optimizer component. Remove the extra components and build again.

ato:error:noDescriptor:description: The component has to sit on the same GameObject as the VRCAvatarDescriptor.
